global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender noodles and menma bamboo shoots. Topped with chopped green onions and minced pork, it sits in a white bowl on a wooden table under warm, soft lighting.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with subtle texture and natural wood finish.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and rich, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale brown, slightly translucent, with fibrous texture and irregular, curled shapes.
